recommendations.title: Provide oral rehydration solution (ORS), not water alone
recommendations.rationale: Extreme band — ISO 7933 PHS water-loss limit (5% body mass) is a realistic risk at this exposure level for unacclimatised workers.
recommendations.basis: ISO 7933:2023 water-loss limit (5 % of body mass)

recommendations.title: Heatwave conditions: published mortality risk is elevated
recommendations.rationale: Daily mean 37.7 °C is above the local 97th percentile (34.7 °C) for 2 or more consecutive days. In Ahmedabad, daily deaths on such days were about 1.49x those on non-heatwave days (95% CI 1.39-1.58). A published association, not a forecast of deaths.
recommendations.basis: de Bont et al., Environ Int 2024;184:108461 (PMC11790314), Ahmedabad city-specific estimate; not validated locally

recommendations.title: Increase water intake frequency (every 15-20 minutes if outdoors)
recommendations.rationale: HeatLens score 96.2 (Extreme, uncalibrated), driven by Heat Debt (Plan C) — dehydration risk rises with either heat load.
recommendations.basis: NIOSH Heat Stress: Hydration fact sheet (2017): 1 cup (8 oz) of water every 15-20 minutes when working in the heat

hap_trigger_basis: Red Alert - Extreme Heat Alert Day: city max temperature 47.0 C (measured at Ahmedabad airport station, WMO 42647 (NOAA GSOD)) against AMC thresholds (Yellow >= 41.1 C, Orange >= 43.1 C, Red >= 45.0 C; AMC Heat Action Plan 2019 (Easy Read), section IV.A 'Color Signals for Heat Alert', p.3). Context, not used for the level: HeatLens thermal-stress band Extreme; published-heatwave exposure tier heatwave.

health.source: de Bont et al., Environ Int 2024;184:108461 (PMC11790314)

cap_preview.headline: AMC Red Alert - Extreme Heat Alert Day - Ramol Hathijan, 2010-05-21
cap_preview.description: HeatLens score 96.2 (Extreme), regime CUMULATIVE_DEBT, dominant driver Heat Debt (Plan C). Daily mean 37.7 C is inside a heatwave by the published definition (2+ days above 34.7 C); Ahmedabad daily mortality was about 1.49x non-heatwave days (95% CI 1.39-1.58). Uncalibrated HeatLens composite index - not a validated health-outcome forecast.
